metric_computation.groundedness: fraction of required evidence facts present in retrieved passages
metric_computation.context_relevance: fraction of retrieved passages overlapping required evidence terms
metric_computation.faithfulness: required evidence facts reflected by rationale/evidence, with route match bonus
metric_computation.hallucination_rate: unsupported rationale sentence fraction plus unresolved-citation fraction

deliberate_change: v1 to v2 adds an explicit search for linked conditions, exceptions and facilities before concluding.
